title: airgap-minimal-shrinkwrap-and-almalinux-support-with-registry-replication-module
author: Sofia Martinez
description: Motivation: support customers that must run private/on-prem installs on RHEL derivatives after CentOS8 EOL and enable much smaller, curated airgap bundles that operators can generate for minimum-viable installs. This PR adds AlmaLinux 8/9 node support to the installer images and packer build pipelines, introduces a 'shrinkwrap' bundle manifest and generator that produces component-level minimal bundles for air-gapped installs, and provides a Terraform module to replicate selected container images into a local registry (with optional Content Trust and signed manifests). The Helm chart changes add an initPreload hook template to load images into local registries before startup and a TLS-pinning option for registries with self-signed certs. Operational improvements: preflight checks for kernel modules and container runtimes were extended for AlmaLinux variants, and we add an atomic rollback script + helm rollback wrapper that replays saved release manifests from delta bundle metadata. Backwards compatibility: old full-bundle installer remains the default; shrinkwrap is opt-in via `bundle-profile=shrinkwrap` and has a documented schema. Includes docs and examples for generating a shrinkwrap bundle, configuring registry replication, and an e2e smoke test for an AlmaLinux VM in an air-gapped network. Checklist: [x] packer image builds for AlmaLinux8/9, [x] shrinkwrap spec + generator, [x] terraform registry-replication module, [x] helm initPreload and cert handling, [x] preflight & rollback scripts, [x] docs and usage examples, [x] CI e2e on GCP VM approximating airgap, [x] manual verification on customer-sim cluster. Related: ENG-8132 for shrinkwrap design doc, SUP-2211 customer report on CentOS8 deprecation. Breaking change: none by default; shrinkwrap opt-in.

release_notes: Adds AlmaLinux 8/9 packer builds for air-gapped installs; introduces 'shrinkwrap' bundle profile for generating minimal component bundles; new Terraform module for replicating selected images into a local registry; Helm chart changes to preload images and handle self-signed registry certs; atomic rollback tooling for delta upgrades. Opt-in features—no default breaking changes.
